lesson.title: Ba thư viện quản lý thiết bị

lesson.title: netmiko
lesson.code:
from netmiko import ConnectHandler
device = {'device_type': 'cisco_ios', 'host': '10.1.1.1',
          'username': 'admin', 'password': 'Cisco123', 'secret': 'En@ble'}
with ConnectHandler(**device) as conn:
    conn.enable()
    out = conn.send_command('show ip interface brief')
    print(out)
    cfg = ['interface Loopback99', 'description AUTO-NETMIKO']
    print(conn.send_config_set(cfg))
    conn.save_config()
lesson.note: send_command trả chuỗi; use_textfsm=True parse thành list dict (cần template).

lesson.title: NAPALM
lesson.code:
from napalm import get_network_driver
driver = get_network_driver('ios')
dev = driver('10.1.1.1', 'admin', 'Cisco123')
dev.open()
print(dev.get_facts()['os_version'])
dev.load_merge_candidate(config='ntp server 10.1.1.100')
print(dev.compare_config())
dev.commit_config()      # hoặc dev.discard_config()
dev.close()
lesson.note: Getter trả dữ liệu chuẩn hóa giống nhau cho Cisco IOS, NX-OS, Juniper, Arista.

    reply = m.get_config(source='running', filter=flt)
